newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 12.

text.p: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd and Sega Enterprises Ltd, Japan's biggest video game machine maker, plan a tie up to build theme parks with high-tech game attractions in Japan and Asia. Mitsubishi will offer hardware, while Sega will provide software.

Mitsubishi Corp Finance Plc, a wholly owned British financial unit of Japanese trading house Mitsubishi Corp, is expected to report a 20 percent rise in pre-tax profit to more than $30 million for the year to March 1997, helped by the high credit standing of its parent company. If needed, Mitsubishi Corp Finance is able to raise up to 12 billion dollars at low interest rates in European capital markets.

Sumitomo Corp plans to set up an online settlement company in Singapore by the end of April in cooperation with the local government-affiliated Singapore Technology (ST) group. The company will be capitalised at several hundred billion yen.
